images.note: one image serves two classes: `true` and `miscaptioned` share the same true_N.jpg, so their coverage is identical by construction

notes: single undivided CSV; image_path resolved relative to it

images are NOT shipped with the corpus. The register points at github.com/stevejpapad/relevant-evidence-detection (RED-DOT), which carries VERITE's CSVs and precomputed evidence only. The images were hydrated from true_url/false_url in VERITE_articles.csv -- see data/reports/hydration_verite.json for per-class recovery.
